result.summary: The page is largely intact. The partially visible category chip and restaurant card at the right edge, and the card cut off at the bottom, are expected scroll behavior. One minor accessibility concern remains in the search field.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray background, giving it weak contrast and making it harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text so it meets WCAG contrast guidelines against the input background.
